content.text: /ext:medcp How many breast cancer patients are currently active in our records?
I'll check the clinical database structure first, then query for active breast cancer patients.

This is an OMOP CDM database. "Breast cancer" is a condition, and "currently active" means the patient's observation period is still open (no end, or end in the future). Let me identify the breast cancer concepts and count distinct persons with an active observation period.

arguments.sql_query:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT co.person_id) AS n_breast_cancer_active
FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca
  ON co.condition_concept_id = ca.descendant_concept_id
JOIN omop.concept anc
  ON ca.ancestor_concept_id = anc.concept_id
JOIN omop.observation_period op
  ON co.person_id = op.person_id
WHERE anc.concept_name = 'Malignant tumor of breast'
  AND anc.vocabulary_id = 'SNOMED'
  AND op.observation_period_end_date >= CURRENT_DATE;

content.text: The data ends 2026-02-26, so no observation period reaches today (2026-07-23) — that's why "active as of now" returns 0. The sensible interpretation is patients whose observation period was still open at the dataset's end. Let me count breast cancer patients whose observation period extends to the data's max end date, and verify the concept match is finding patients at all.

arguments.sql_query:
-- Total breast cancer patients (any time), and those "active" at dataset end (2026-02-26)
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT co.person_id) AS n_breast_cancer_total,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN op.observation_period_end_date >= '2026-02-26' THEN co.person_id END) AS n_active_at_data_end
FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca
  ON co.condition_concept_id = ca.descendant_concept_id
JOIN omop.concept anc
  ON ca.ancestor_concept_id = anc.concept_id
JOIN omop.observation_period op
  ON co.person_id = op.person_id
WHERE anc.concept_name = 'Malignant tumor of breast'
  AND anc.vocabulary_id = 'SNOMED';

**~7,900 breast cancer patients** are currently active in the records.

Details:
- **48,153** patients total have a breast cancer diagnosis (SNOMED "Malignant tumor of breast" and all descendants) ever recorded.
- **7,900** of them are "active" — their OMOP observation period was still open at the dataset's latest date (2026-02-26).

Note: the data extends only to **2026-02-26**, so no observation period reaches today's date (2026-07-23); a literal "as of today" filter returns 0. I therefore counted patients still under observation at the dataset's end, which is the standard way to express "currently active" in this snapshot.
